The <b>Great Conchflies</b> are a dual main [[Bosses (Silksong)|boss]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are a pair of elder [[Conchfly|Conchflies]] bearing a huge coral horn.<ref name=journal1/> They block the path to the [[Pinstress]] and [[Sands of Karak]].

==Background==
The Great Conchflies are two elder Conchflies that have mated, now being incredibly close.<ref name="journal1">Great Conchflies [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Elder Conchfly crowned with a huge coral horn. Once partnered with a mate, they will rarely be seen alone."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==
In the northwest section of the [[Blasted Steps]], Hornet encounters a room filled with pinkish conch shells. Entering this room causes the doorways to become blocked, and two Great Conchflies appear, roaring in unison. After one is defeated, the other retreats into the background, giving a final roar before fleeing.

[[Nuu]] appears in their arena later on, inspecting the corpse of the defeated Great Conchfly.

The surviving Great Conchfly can later be fought in the [[Sands of Karak]] as the [[Raging Conchfly]] boss.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
{{AttackDisclaimer}}

The encounter begins with the Great Conchflies entering the arena, one flying in from the ceiling and the other from the floor, roaring when they meet in the centre of the room. Afterwards, they continue their respective initial trajectories and burrow out of the arena. The fight then begins with the pair of bosses having the following shared move set:

* <b>Drill Dash</b>: Both Great Conchflies burst out of the walls, ground, or ceiling, travel directly across the arena, and then burrow back out of the arena.
* <b>Conch Spit</b>: A single Great Conchfly descends from a ceiling corner and either stays near the ceiling or floats to the ground before spitting a conch projectile in a diagonal direction towards [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]. The conch deals {{Damage|1}} and ricochets 3 times before breaking. After the projectile bounces twice, the Great Conchfly burrows directly downwards while the other Great Conchfly simultaneously performs a Drill Dash attack.
* <b>Drill Slam</b>: A single Great Conchfly burrows out of a ceiling corner, flies horizontally across the room and then burrows downwards into the ground. When the first Great Conchfly is burrowing into the ground, the other Great Conchfly can either perform a simultaneous Drill Dash, or perform a single Conch Spit attack.

A pillar of rumbling sand indicates where a Great Conchfly will emerge. Contact with a Great Conchfly deals {{Damage|2}}.

<hr />

The conch projectiles can be hit back towards the Great Conchfly to deal 15 damage to it.

Hornet can avoid most attacks by positioning herself in the corner of the arena. Jumping once toward the wall and sliding down places her in a spot where Conch Spit and Drill Slam cannot reach. The only threat is when a Great Conchfly uses Drill Dash across the floor, but this can be safely avoided with a simple jump.

==Location ==
The Great Conchflies can be found below the Blasted Steps Bellway, west of the central tall room, the entrance marked by a blue banner displaying crossed pins.

== Trivia ==
* The Great Conchflies have a unique response to the Needolin, with both emerging from where they are currently drilled into the stone to sing together. They do not sing if only one Conchfly is currently visible.
* According to [[Nuu]], the insides of a Great Conchfly are very sweet.
